'''Zoe Martin''' is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is also credited by her birth name, '''Meredith Zeitlin'''. She is currently affiliated with KMR Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Martin was born as Meredith Zeitlin. As an adult, she became a voice actress and worked on a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|DP}} and has notably voiced [[Angie]], {{Ash}}'s friend from the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]]; and [[Mairin]], [[Alain]]'s traveling companion from the [[Mega Evolution Specials]]. Martin currently resides in New York City, New York.
